column3: Sharp pixels: every DS pixel an exact square, no blur (4x4 on the RG DS Plus, 2x2 with a frame on the RG DS). None scales smoothly. Your own: .frag files in banana/shaders, named with letters, digits and . _ + - only. Crisp: exact pixel-area scaling. Grid and LCD: the DS's screen grid. Colours: the DS's own, duller colours. CRT: a TV's scanlines. FSR: smooth edges, the heaviest. None costs no GPU work.
Accurate is melonDS's own. Fast lets the two CPUs run longer between meeting (about 10% faster), but it can break a game: Golden Sun: Dark Dawn loses its 3D world.
How loud a word or a blow must be to reach the game. Off: the game hears nothing from the mic, and the in-game menu's Blow still works for a game that wants one.
The card on the network: \\{address}\banana in Windows' File Explorer, smb://{address}/banana on a Mac (Finder, Go, Connect to Server). {sharing}
